svg.aria-label: Write-ColorEX writes text to the PowerShell host, as Write-Host does, with far more control: any color your terminal can show, text styles, gradients, markup tags, highlighted patterns, links, padding that counts emoji and CJK characters correctly, and logging to a file. It finds what your terminal supports and falls back gracefully where it supports less.
